name: Bald Ridge Enterprises, LLC
old_description: Bald Ridge Enterprises is the trusted name for sheet metal in Wyoming and Montana, delivering precision craftsmanship in architectural sheet metal and metal construction. From custom roofing and siding to premanufactured metal buildings, our work is built to perform and designed to last.
about:
Bald Ridge Enterprises operates from Cody, Wyoming, serving customers across Wyoming and Montana. The company was founded nearly four decades ago on family values and a dedication to craftsmanship, growing from a small local shop into a recognized contractor. It is certified as a Women-Owned Small Business with US Federal Contractor Registration.

The company provides complete metal construction services with all fabrication performed in-house. Its capabilities include pre-manufactured steel buildings, metal roofing systems, metal siding and exterior components (soffits, fascia, gutters, downspouts), specialty metalwork such as snow bars and chimney caps, and carpentry. The team handles design, fabrication, and installation for projects of varying scale.

Bald Ridge serves commercial, agricultural, residential, institutional, and government clients. Examples include custom roofing and siding for homes, pre-engineered steel buildings for farms and commercial facilities, and architectural sheet metal for institutional and government projects throughout the two-state region.

The company emphasizes in-house fabrication for quality control, adherence to the Architectural Sheet Metal Manual, and engineering for the harsh weather conditions of Wyoming and Montana. Its family-focused culture and status as a women-owned small business are cited as key differentiators, along with standard one-year warranties and extended manufacturer guarantees.
